text: You'll love this Onion Roasted Potatoes recipe because it's a delicious and gluten-free option that fits within your 60-minute time frame. The use of Lipton Onion Soup Mix adds a rich flavor without requiring any gluten-containing ingredients. As someone who enjoys potatoes, you'll appreciate the hearty chunks of potato roasted to perfection. Plus, the recipe is quick and easy to prepare, making it a great choice for a weeknight dinner or a weekend meal.
